audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Teemo Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, and Level 1 to neither — but the prose says the opposite in four of those five rows.
audit.why: content.early opens 'At level 1 Teemo controls the range war completely', so Level 1 is his. whys[2] calls Level 3 'your first real kill window'. whys[5] and content.late call first item 'your clearest ownership window'. whys[6] describes 2+ items as a map problem rather than a lost duel. The packet chart (Teemo / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Swain / Skill) matches every one of those statements at a 50.95% win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 5 and 6 moved to the packet read as matched full/content pairs, with ratings on the two rows that changed owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid says 'Track Blinding Dart's 13-second cooldown mentally'.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank. The page's entire trading model is 'commit during the Dart gap', so a player counting to 13 gives away roughly half his available windows and steps in at the exact moment it comes back up. This is the most damaging number on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] reads 'Kite backward with passive Ghost and Never-get-reached against your E-root attempts'. Neither of those is a Teemo ability.
audit.why: His passive is Guerrilla Warfare — invisibility while standing still, maintained while moving in brush, with bonus attack speed on breaking it — and his movement tool is Move Quick (W), a 14s speed buff. 'Ghost' and 'Never-get-reached' are fabrications, and they hide the two things that actually matter: he vanishes in brush, and he re-emerges attacking faster.
audit.corrected: Move Quick breaks the root angle; Guerrilla Warfare hides him in brush and gives attack speed when he steps out.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (P Guerrilla Warfare, W Move Quick cd 14)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says Vision of Empire reveals him, and nothing says Toxic Shot is on-hit.
audit.why: Vision of Empire's own text: 'Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.' Against the one champion in the game whose passive is indefinite invisibility in brush, that is the single most valuable line in Swain's kit and it appears nowhere. Separately the _missing-interactions entry flags 'Teemo applies on-hit through Toxic Shot (E) — their damage scales with attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong'; his damage is magic and attack-speed-scaled, which is why Mercury's Treads and MR are already correct in report[8] and armour would not be.
audit.corrected: Drop Vision of Empire on the brush to reveal him and take the fragment; blunt Toxic Shot with MR, not armour.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName on 'Noxious Traps' in content.late is a false positive — it is the real ability name in the plural, one edit away from the canonical singular.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a genuine coin-flip window. Teemo's poison ramps up his sustained damage while your R is still one level away, and shrooms begin appearing on lane chokes — step on one before an all-in and the shred plus slow can invert a winning fight. Track Blinding Dart's 13-second cooldown mentally; commit your pattern only during that gap and bail the moment the Dart refreshes. At 6 the matchup tips slightly your way: Demonic Ascension drains faster than his poison and shrooms deal damage, so extended fights now favour you. Bait his Blinding Dart by fake-stepping in, let it whiff or let him spend it on a CS trade, then run the full W-E-root-R chain while he has no answer to your sustain.

edits.before: Kite backward with passive Ghost and Never-get-reached against your E-root attempts
edits.after: Break your root angle with Move Quick's speed, then vanish in brush with Guerrilla Warfare

edits.before: Use W to zone Teemo off the wave and force him to choose between Dart or positioning
edits.after: Drop Vision of Empire on his brush — it reveals him out of Guerrilla Warfare invisibility

edits.before: Teemo's Blinding Dart comes online at level 1 — it blanks your auto-attack damage but not your spells, so the moment you misread it as a spell-block he wins the trade.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and blanks only your autos — Death's Hand and Nevermove land through it, so eat the blind and keep casting while it runs.

edits.before: Both kits are fully scaled but Teemo's shrooms begin controlling choke points and his poison sustained damage beats yours in short trades. Track the Dart timer and play the gap.
edits.after: Teemo's shrooms start owning the choke points and Toxic Shot poisons on-hit, so his damage scales with his attack speed rather than AP — MR, not armour, is what blunts it here.

notes: The 13-second Blinding Dart cooldown in content.mid was the worst error here — it is 7 flat, and the page's whole trading model is built on counting that gap. Vision of Empire revealing Teemo out of Guerrilla Warfare was completely absent despite being Swain's cleanest answer to the one champion whose passive is permanent brush invisibility; the mirror audit notes this is likely missing from every Swain matchup, not just this one, and the same is true of the 'E (Vision of Empire)' slot swap it found. Chart moved to the packet read, which resolves four rows that contradicted this page's own prose.
